title: Deterministic Personal Office model gateway and provider routing

implementationCommit.subject: feat(agent): add deterministic model gateway
implementationCommit.scope: versioned model-route contract, fail-closed managed/custom resolution, request-frozen providers, strict endpoint validation, exact same-route retry, secret-free diagnostics, fake-only tests and product contract

handoffCommit.subject: docs(personal-office): hand off Loop 06 model gateway

contractCompliance: Defines MODEL_ROUTE_CONTRACT_VERSION 1 with strict ModelRouteDecision and ModelRouteRequirements types.
Hashes canonical secret-free routing evidence with SHA-256; the hash is integrity evidence, not a signature or authority proof.
Custom disabled selects one explicit managed route. Custom enabled with missing or invalid config or a missing key throws a typed fail-closed reason and never falls back to managed.
Provider, endpoint, model, credential source and retry policy are resolved once and frozen for the request lifetime.
The sole retry is exact known JSON HTTP 400 streaming incompatibility, once, on the same endpoint, provider, model, messages and idempotency key; only stream changes to false.
Custom URL parsing rejects credentials, query, fragment, controls, backslashes, encoded or ambiguous paths, unsupported schemes, remote HTTP and non-exact textual loopback aliases.
Official Izzi classification requires canonical HTTPS on the default port and exact izziapi.com or api.izziapi.com host; source and idempotency headers are not attached elsewhere.
Managed routing accepts only official Izzi HTTPS, reads local configuration once, ignores gateway-auth fields and uses only the provider key or authenticated access token.
Provider errors, diagnostics and route decisions do not include raw response bodies, transport messages, URLs, queries, fragments, credentials or authorization headers.

Persisted custom configuration is normalized before save; getConfig returns only validated normalized configuration or null, while getConfigValidation preserves typed missing versus invalid state without returning raw bytes.
AgentService resolves one route, records one secret-free agent.model-route diagnostic and does not add a second context path.
The protected customProvider:chat host seam remains byte-identical, custom-only and outside managed/custom selection; invalid stored config is blocked before it reaches the shared URL helper.
prohibitedPathsRespected: integration ledger, lease registry and quarantine
deployment, publish and real provider/network side effects

surfaces: custom endpoint SSRF and URL smuggling
controls: Enabled-invalid custom state fails closed with stable typed reason codes.
Remote plain HTTP, userinfo, query, fragment, controls, encoded paths, dot segments, duplicate separators and loopback aliases are rejected.
Managed requests reject non-Izzi origins before network access and ignore gateway-auth configuration.
Provider HTTP and transport errors are sanitized and never reflect raw response or transport data.
Route evidence contains origin only and never contains path, query, fragment, userinfo, API key or authorization header.
Retry matching requires exact known JSON error.message text and preserves endpoint, model, messages and idempotency identity.
Raw persisted invalid URLs cannot cross getConfig, IPC configuration reads or host/provider construction.

reviewHistory.socratesChallenge: PASS for e36bb4a. The committed selector meets the deterministic decision, fail-closed routing, frozen-route, exact retry, endpoint, secret and no-second-context-path requirements. The protected host seam is custom-only and cannot select or fall back to managed; its missing v1 diagnostic, limited response-body reflection and broader legacy retry remain documented residuals outside the Loop 06 selector. The reviewer performed read-only commit/diff/scope checks and did not independently assert producer test counts.

residualRisks: The protected Loop 05 customProvider:chat/runHostAgentTurn path does not emit the version-1 agent.model-route diagnostic, may reflect a bounded portion of a remote response body in legacy errors, and retains its older broader streaming downgrade behavior. It is custom-only, cannot select managed and requires a future exact lease to change.
The route decision SHA-256 is deterministic integrity/content-addressing evidence, not an authentication signature or authorization source.
Full desktop suite, production build and integration-level GitNexus checks remain W0 duties on a complete dependency installation.

A custom configuration targeting an official Izzi host remains provider-native for credit/billing classification because its credential relationship is user-configured, even though strict official headers and exact retry policy apply.
